rejected_candidates.name: Funds
rejected_candidates.reason: A fund is a legal entity that another legal entity manages; it cannot be described without naming its manager, so it is a role, and every fund is also a legal entity.

rejected_candidates.name: Portfolio Companies
rejected_candidates.reason: A portfolio company is a company in which a fund holds a stake; it is a role of a legal entity.

rejected_candidates.name: Investors
rejected_candidates.reason: An investor is a legal entity while it commits capital or holds a stake. It is a role.

rejected_candidates.name: Holdings
rejected_candidates.reason: A holding is the net of acquisitions and exits as at a date. It is worked out from transactions and is never stored.

rejected_candidates.name: Capital Calls and Distributions
rejected_candidates.reason: Each is a transaction in which money moves between a fund and its investors, and Transactions already covers it.

rejected_candidates.name: Valuations
rejected_candidates.reason: Valuations are not a domain of their own. An instrument's price is held with the instrument, and the value of a legal entity is held as a Valuation concept in the Transactions domain, linked to the legal entity valued.
